fact: FB Attorneys says Tanzania has no specific law regulating AI or deepfakes, and that the government's AI Strategic Framework acknowledges AI-generated misinformation and deepfakes are not comprehensively addressed in current law.

Parliamentary committee chair Fatuma Toufiq, speaking for the Speaker at an AI training for MPs in Dodoma, said Tanzania has no policy or law on how AI is to be run and supervised so that its negative uses are dealt with.
